units.rawText: Curse you...
units.displayText: Curse you...

units.rawText: Ugh...

units.rawText: Being Entropized... Really sucks...

spans.text: Being Entropized... Really sucks...

spans.text: I need to stay lucid. I grab one of the wooden splinters from the trailer and stab it hard into my thigh—

units.displayText: Urgh... Gwaargh...

spans.text: Urgh... Gwaargh...

units.rawText: ...It's not enough.
units.displayText: ...It's not enough.

units.displayText: I stab the shard deeper in and twist it.

spans.text: I stab the shard deeper in and twist it.

units.displayText: Urgh—AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!

spans.text: Urgh—AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!

units.rawText: It hurts so much that it overcomes the feeling of Entropization and allows me to stay conscious for a while.
units.displayText: It hurts so much that it overcomes the feeling of Entropization and allows me to stay conscious for a while.

spans.text: I guess... Uuuurgh... I bought enough time...

units.displayText: Now then... one last thing...

spans.text: Now then... one last thing...

units.rawText: In order to end all this... In order to have the "Entropized Irregular Agent" completely disappear...
units.displayText: In order to end all this... In order to have the "Entropized Irregular Agent" completely disappear...

spans.text: In order to end all this... In order to have the "Entropized Irregular Agent" completely disappear...

units.displayText: I move my injured leg with great difficulty, then enter another compartment in full view of Faith before fleeing at top speed through a blind spot in her vision—

spans.text: I move my injured leg with great difficulty, then enter another compartment in full view of Faith before fleeing at top speed through a blind spot in her vision—

units.displayText: I hear the sound of footsteps stepping over the debris.

spans.text: I hear the sound of footsteps stepping over the debris.

units.rawText: ...Looks like things aren't going my way. Faith wasn't completely fooled by that trick.
units.displayText: ...Looks like things aren't going my way. Faith wasn't completely fooled by that trick.

spans.text: ...Looks like things aren't going my way. Faith wasn't completely fooled by that trick.

units.rawText: The footsteps draw nearer. Fortunately, the basic disguise program is working, so Faith won't discover my true identity, which would endanger the relationship between the Oasis and the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Still, it would kind of suck if everything ended here...

spans.text: Still, it would kind of suck if everything ended here...

units.displayText: You're the Intermediate Sanctifier... Faith, I believe?

units.displayText: Verifying identity... Agent is Persicaria of the Oasis, on the whitelist.

spans.text: Verifying identity... Agent is Persicaria of the Oasis, on the whitelist.

units.displayText: Please leave this place and do not interfere with Sanctifier activities.

spans.text: Please leave this place and do not interfere with Sanctifier activities.

units.displayText: The Sanctifiers should be working with the Oasis, right?

spans.text: The Sanctifiers should be working with the Oasis, right?

units.displayText: I brought people to inspect a shipment bound for the Oasis... What happened to it?

spans.text: I brought people to inspect a shipment bound for the Oasis... What happened to it?

units.displayText: An Entropized agent contaminated the cargo. The Sanctifiers are pursuing them.

spans.text: An Entropized agent contaminated the cargo. The Sanctifiers are pursuing them.

units.rawText: And where is that Entropized agent now?
units.displayText: And where is that Entropized agent now?

spans.text: And where is that Entropized agent now?

units.rawText: Their signal has vanished, so they should have died in the explosion just now... But just in case, I am going to check again.

units.displayText: No. This shipment has been contaminated by the Entropy. The Sanctifiers will take care of them.

units.displayText: ...I believe you can see the devastation all around you.

spans.text: I need to make sure.

units.displayText: ...Professor!
